# 2 Baruch Chapter 20 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** "So the time allotted to this world will be cut short for those living in it, because of how greatly they have sinned.

**2** The Most High has run out of patience with the inhabitants of the earth. He will not hold back from that point on.

**3** So gather yourself and go into the forest. Give yourself over to grief and mourning out there. If you stay and fast for seven days, I will come back to you and tell you what is going to happen to the nations.

**4** You will learn what is coming and what will follow. Your prayer has reached the Most High. Holy angels have been assigned to you, guarding you until now.

**5** I will not withdraw them until everything I have told you has been fulfilled.

**6** And he also said to me: "Listen — I am establishing my covenant with you and with your descendants from this day forward, forever. I will never forget you; I will keep you in my memory forever."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. "Run out of patience" for "waxed impatient." "Gather yourself" for "command your memory" — PNEUMA contextualizes the unusual phrase. "Assigned to you" for "sent to you." V.6 covenant rendered with personal warmth.*
